description: How far a model covers a GIS DMA (wanda_health_v1 dma_health.coverage), by in-network GIS pipe length named in the model (FID or FID_n). A row exists from one GIS pipe of the DMA in the model.

codes.label: Modelled: 50 % or more of the DMA's in-network GIS length is in the model
Edge: under 50 % in the model (facts only, never flagged)
